evidence.notice: Historical replay of the team's ERA5-Land June–September 2023 rainfall (land average over 3–15°N, 33–48°E, monthly product). Contract dates are a separate future local test season. The source year is inside the calibration sample; this is an illustration, not an out-of-sample backtest. Oracle delivery, test identities and valueless tokens are local simulations.
